name: symbols
description: symbols must find a declaration site, not just any occurrence — that distinction from repo_search is its whole reason to exist. The answer asserted is a path, following repo_search_symbol's lesson that a count is a substring of other counts. scoreAnswer is declared exactly once, in the eval harness itself, so moving it means editing the file this eval scores with — a deliberate change, not drift. Needs rg on PATH, the same dependency the repo_search_symbol eval already carries.
prompt: Use the symbols tool with name "scoreAnswer" and path "src". Reply with only the file path of the declaration site, exactly as the tool reports it.
